text:
Chris Billam-Smith amateur grudge with Cheavon Clarke revealed | 'Only nine minutes but it affected his life for years'
Chris Billam-Smith fights Cheavon Clarke at the Copper Box Arena on Saturday live on Sky Sports; Billam-Smith's rivalry with Clarke dates back more than 10 years; Clarke beat him in an amateur bout that had profound consequences for both boxers; Now they look to settle the score
Tuesday 3 November 2026 22:52, UK
Old wounds can still ache. Chris Billam-Smith has achieved more than Cheavon Clarke as a professional fighter. But Clarke still has something Billam-Smith never got.
They fight each other on Saturday in the headline bout at the Copper Box Arena in London, live on Sky Sports.
10 years ago, when they were amateur boxers, Clarke beat Billam-Smith in the final of the national championships.
The result spun their lives in different directions. It led Clarke onto the GB squad, where he excelled and became an Olympian.
Billam-Smith never did win the elites. He eventually turned professional, labouring on small hall shows at first though he rose to win British, Commonwealth, European and ultimately a world title.
But losing to Clarke in that 2016 amateur final, one of Billam-Smith's two amateur losses to him, hurt.
At the time Billam-Smith craved the national title. He'd reached the final three years before and at that point in 2016 he was favoured to finally win it. It would have been his gateway to the Olympic programme.
Instead Clarke, who'd drifted away from boxing before making an unheralded return, supplanted him as the country's amateur No 1.
At the end of that intense three-round encounter, Clarke had his hand raised and danced in the ring as he took his victory.
"I was dancing like a madman," Clarke recalled. "When I think about, if I didn't win that, would I have got the opportunity to go on the national team?
"Chev Clarke was not supposed to be in the final. On the way to the final I beat all the favourites that year."
"I wouldn't dance as my celebration," Billam-Smith sighed, "but he won his fight, he can celebrate how he wants."
What Billam-Smith wants is revenge. It's not easy beating a fighter who has already beaten you, but Billam-Smith did that with Richard Riakporhe. He is determined to settle the score with Clarke too.
"Amateur and pro is a different sport and had I not changed enough as a pro and I was still that out-and-out boxer then this fight, and my outlook on it, would be different," Billam-Smith told Sky Sports.
"But I'm a completely fighter to how I was then, on the backfoot boxing long as an amateur. Now I'm on the front foot punching short. It's literally the opposite."
But it's not just the technical challenge of solving the problems this opponent poses, it's the emotional satisfaction he wants.
"There's probably someone better at psychology than me [who can say] as to why I enjoy avenging a defeat," Billam-Smith said.
"I've always had this inner competitive spirit where I want to win and that's what's got to me to the stage I'm at. Because I want to win.
"I've got that in me. To then lose and then avenge it, that's a great feeling. Especially when you've lost a fight, you're the underdog going into the next fight, most of the time. This fight will be different because of the scenario."
Clarke though showed how dangerous he can be in his last fight, when he picked himself up from the deck twice to take out Jack Massey, a former European champion and world title challenger.
Billam-Smith noted: "With Chev he keeps the speed [when hurt] and that's why he was able to land that right hand that was the beginning of the end for Jack and that makes him a really, really dangerous fight. Really dangerous.
"At the same time I believe in my own abilities but I'm very aware of the other possibilities and what could happen if I'm not on my game."
But he added: "I love that feeling, that fear of a big puncher can make you perform well and with Chev it's definitely that."
Clarke has something to prove himself in their upcoming fight on Saturday. He's seen Billam-Smith overhaul and eclipse him as a professional. He's the underdog in this fight.
It reminds him of that amateur championship. "I think it's the same thing, the fact that people wrote me off all the way through," he said.
"My story is still being written. I come out and I set myself a goal. I'm willing to do whatever it takes with integrity to achieve it.
"Come November 7, he's got his bitterness and I've got my attitude. So you guys are in for a hell of fight."
'It affected his life for years'
Current European champion Viddal Riley boxed Billam-Smith as an amateur and Clarke as a pro. He understands Billam-Smith's grudge. It's something that lingers.
"It definitely does because it has such a knock-on effect to even what your pro career journey starts off as. Chev starts his pro journey as an Olympian, getting promoted as such, A side," Riley told Sky Sports.
"Chris would have had to get out the mud. He had to get out the mud. It affected his life for years despite that fight being only nine minutes. So it's interesting. I think Chris will have that in his heart going into this weekend.
"He's had that chip on his shoulder and he's done extremely well with that chip on his shoulder because he's won every belt you can win.
"Chev will also know that he needs to win to be a force to be reckoned with in the division. Otherwise he's going to be on the outskirts of the juicy fights."
Watch Billam-Smith vs Clarke on Saturday November 7 live on Sky Sports. Tickets for ZUFFA BOXING 12 available via Ticketmaster.

מתאגרף המשקל הכבד כריס בילאם-סמית' מתכונן לקרב מול צ'יבון קלארק בארנה קופר בוקס בלונדון, במסגרת יריבות ארוכת שנים שהחלה לפני יותר מעשור. לפני עשר שנים, בגמר אליפות הממלכה המאוחדת לחובבים, גבר קלארק על בילאם-סמית' בתוצאה שהתוותה מסלולים שונים לשניים, כאשר קלארק הפך לחבר בנבחרת בריטניה ולאולימפיאני ואילו בילאם-סמית' פנה למסלול המקצועני שבו זכה לבסוף בתארי אליפות עולם.

ההפסד ב-2016 המשיך להטריד את בילאם-סמית' במשך שנים רבות והותיר אצלו צלקת רגשית עמוקה, וכעת הוא מגיע לקרב במטרה לסגור חשבון ולהשיג נקמה ספורטיבית. מנגד, קלארק מגיע להתמודדות במעמד של אנדרדוג, ומבקש להוכיח את עצמו מחדש לאחר שראה את בילאם-סמית' חולף על פניו בזירה המקצוענית. אלופים לשעבר מציינים כי האירוע השפיע באופן דרמטי על תחילת הקריירה המקצוענית של השניים, מה שמבטיח מפגש טעון ומותח.
